tagline: Powering the immune system to transform lives
hero_kpi_rationale: R&D expenses are a key structural indicator for biotechnology companies in the clinical phase, reflecting investment in the drug development pipeline

kpis.name: R&D Expenses
kpis.description: Company's research and development expenses in 2025

kpis.name: ECLIPSE Program
kpis.explanation: Registration-directed development program for chronic hepatitis delta (CHD)
kpis.description: Three phase 3 clinical trials for the combination of tobevibart and elebsiran in the treatment of hepatitis delta. ECLIPSE 1 trial data are expected in Q4 2026, with ECLIPSE 2 and 3 trial data expected in Q1 2027.

risks.title: Dependence on Financing
risks.score_rationale: The company is highly dependent on external financing to continue its research and development activities. The 10-K indicates that the company may be forced to delay, reduce, or discontinue certain R&D programs if funding is not available.

risks.title: Clinical Development Risks
risks.score_rationale: Clinical development timelines and costs can vary significantly. The 10-K states that timelines, costs, and the probability of success may differ materially from expectations depending on multiple factors, including patient enrollment, additional safety studies, and regulatory requirements.

risks.title: Regulatory Risks
risks.score_rationale: Regulatory requirements and approval processes may change and impact the development of product candidates. Commercial success depends on obtaining regulatory approvals in the United States, Europe, and other jurisdictions.

risks.title: Competition Risks
risks.score_rationale: Competition in the biotechnology and oncology sectors is intense. Vir Biotechnology competes with other companies developing TCEs and therapies for infectious diseases and cancer.

risks.title: Liquidity Risks
risks.score_rationale: Although the company has $781.6 million in cash and investments, it may face liquidity challenges if its operational needs increase or if collaborations do not materialize as expected.

risks.title: Reputation and Partnership Risks
risks.score_rationale: Reputation and partnership relationships are critical to the success of collaborations, such as those with Astellas, Sanofi, and Norgine. Any negative event affecting these relationships could impact revenues and product development.

ai_positioning.summary: Vir Biotechnology integrates artificial intelligence into its technology development through its proprietary dAIsY AI engine, used for the discovery and engineering of new TCEs in its preclinical candidate pipeline.
evidence: dAIsY AI engine used to discover and engineer PRO-XTEN masked TCEs in preclinical phase
